_comment: Single Grub Hub BA Event Recap for client preview / feedback. Wilson County Fair–style campus activation with realistic engagement counts.
engagements_field: How many consumers did you interact with?

rows.Event Name: University of Michigan — Welcome Week (Client Preview)
rows.Event Location: University of Michigan, 500 S State St, Ann Arbor, MI 48109, USA
rows.Consumer Feedback/Quotes: Lots of freshmen didn't realize campus dining dollars work in the app — once we showed them the link flow, most were excited. A few grad students asked about group orders for study sessions. One student said linking took under a minute and they'd been ordering delivery without knowing about on-campus pickup.
rows.Anything you'd improve or change?: Would love a one-pager QR at the table for the account-link steps — verbal walk-through works but slows the line at peak class change. Also helpful to have a short demo phone ready so students can see the linked account screen before pulling out their own device.
